pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Warm-season:$() sow after the last frost, into warm soil. Sprouts after 110 °C·d above 6 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1500 °C·d$(). Best near 20 °C; stops above 32 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -6 °C (-3 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6-7 (tolerates 5.5-7.8). Roots 0.4 m. Dislikes waterlogging.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 120, P 22, K 120 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 357 cwt/ac (40 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Onion and Onion Seeds.
